rulings.why: Real gap, but the lane exists: the identical wood impulse hardwood-armor already ships a note-carrying MODE with the armour statistics and an 'unequip your worn armor' caveat.

mode.name: Metal Carapace
mode.duration: 10 minutes (Dismissible; using the impulse again ends the old one)
mode.note: Medium metal armor that uses your highest armor proficiency: AC Bonus +3, Dex Cap +2, Check Penalty -2, Speed Penalty -5 ft, Strength +2, Bulk 2, group plate, armor trait noisy. Your real armor's bonuses, runes and magical abilities are suppressed (any that could apply are replicated onto the carapace). You may also form a rusty steel shield in a free hand and Shield Block with it even without that feat, and that hand still counts as free for impulses; the shield crumbles to rust if broken or if it leaves your grasp. At every 3rd level the shield's Hardness +1, HP +4, BT +2. If you take damage from a critical hit the metal shatters and the impulse ends. The app cannot swap armor statistics automatically — unequip your worn armor while this is active.

rulings.why: effectiveUses() fills a missing base limit from the upgrade itself, and 9 shipped feats already carry both an innate cast and a use pool, so the 1/hour retune lands.
The dragonet ancestry is size tiny and build.ts raises body size from any feat sizeOverride (largest wins), so 'small' is read and shown.
limitedUses supports the 'every' multiplier, and the app already tracks printed frequencies of target-side abilities (mummys-despair, emit-defensive-odor).
Gap is real but the named lane is inert: COMPANION_MODS is read only for kinds 'animal' and 'eidolon', and a vehicle renders a static VehicleBlock, so a vehicle mod would be written and never read.

fix.note: COMPANION_MODS is consumed only in deriveAnimalCompanion (mod.kinds.includes('animal')) and the eidolon pass (mod.kinds.includes('eidolon')); CompanionsTab renders a vehicle straight from content.vehicles via VehicleBlock with no mod pass at all, so a kinds:['vehicle'] entry is inert. Needs a vehicle/siege mod pass (speeds + note) before Miraculous Flight and the other vehicle feats can land.

rulings.why: The app already lets any prepared caster hold a slot open and drop ANY spell of rank <= the slot into it at any time (ManageSpellsModal's upTo[rank] pool; 'changes apply to this play session'), so the wildcard slot is already expressible.
smashing-tail grants a strike named Tail and unarmedTraits.match is a case-insensitive substring match, so the traits land only when that strike exists.
lesser-enhance-venom carries limitedUses {1,hour}, and usesUpgrade with 'every' is the shipped consistent-surge / greater-despair pattern.

No lane holds a switchable strike configuration — and the base sterling-dynamo-dedication ships four strikes literally named 'Label', so the dynamo attack needs data repair before a configuration can attach.
Verified blocked: the apparition repertoire picker offers only spells whose traditions include divine, and monstrosity-form is arcane/primal, so the player cannot even add it by hand.
advancedAlchemy is the daily-item-count lane the sibling advanced-alchemy carries as {items:4}; build.ts keeps the best offer, so 5 raises it without double-counting.
resourceMaxSet raises a floor and is exactly what expert-fireworks-crafter and additional-servings carry for the same versatile-vials resource.
hidden-thorn grants the only strike named Thorns, so the deadly d6 cannot reach a thorned-rose character who lacks that feat.
Three sibling breadth feats carry the identical spellSlotBonus, and build.ts builds the archetype entry id as dedicationId + '-casting' = oracle-dedication-casting.
Verified blocked: the repertoire manager filters to spells whose traditions include the entry's tradition, so a cross-tradition repertoire spell cannot be recorded at all.
A claimed domain changes nothing on this character's sheet — it is the deity's domain list that WORSHIPPERS draw on once you Assume Godhood; the sibling claim-cardinal-domains records nothing either.
COMPANION_MODS is read for kinds 'animal' and note-only entries are shipped precedent (stealthy-companion), so the companion card carries it.
telekinetic-hand ships in core.spells, and EffectGrant.innateSpells from a picked option is collected by applyAlwaysOn into the innate entry, so the at-will cantrip reaches the Spells page.

Real pick, wrong lane: effectChoices is a BUILD-time picker, but the text says 'during your daily preparations' — choice.daily (52 shipped feats, PlayState.dailyChoices, re-asked at Rest) is the lane that fits.

choice.prompt: Nudge the Scales — which side of the scales did you place yourself on today?

options.label: Life
options.description: You can be targeted and healed by vitality healing effects, as normal for most living creatures.

options.label: Death
options.description: You gain the void healing ability: you are healed by void effects and other effects that restore Hit Points to undead, rather than by vitality healing.

choice.note: The app cannot flip your healing type — nothing on the sheet changes when you choose death, so apply void healing by hand.

rulings.why: Upheld, but the judge's fix mixed effectChoices with situational and the applier returns at the situational branch, silently dropping the field write — so the fix is the star pair alone, worded to carry the daily pick.

situational.when: vs your sworn kind (chosen at daily preparations; doubled after your reaction)
damaging devotion spells vs your sworn kind (aberration, celestial, dragon, fiend or undead)

rulings.why: Flat +1d4 precision on the player's own Strikes under a positional condition — the same shape as the shipped positional stars.
Container capacity IS enforced (derive.ts computes each container's load against item.capacity.bulk and blocks over-capacity drops), so the +50% has a real number to change and no field to carry it.
A once-per-day self benefit with no tracker; limitedUses {1,day} is the shipped shape for exactly this.
Languages are modelled (ancestry-granted plus Int-based picks, with a rail card) and no feat can grant any — even Multilingual carries nothing, so the lane genuinely does not exist.
stone-body ships as a mode with the identical shape (resistances [{all,10}], duration 'until the end of your next turn', modifiers []), so this is a clone of an existing entry.
A conditional rune effect on the player's own Strikes; the star registry already carries phrase-shaped entries like this.
Flat +2d6 precision on the player's own Strategic Strike under a stated condition; nothing flags it today.
COMPANION_MODS.iwr is read for kinds 'animal' (celestial-mount / fiendish-mount) and faithful-steed grants an animal companion, so the line lands on the steed's block.
RECORD_MARKERS already carries the identical always-on quickened mark for eternal-boost, eternal-composition and full-automation, and core.conditions.quickened exists.
maturityFloor is read by deriveAnimalCompanion and the sibling advanced-reanimated-companion / paragon-companion entries are the same shape.
Same marker lane as the other permanent-quickened feats, with the follower condition carried in the value instead of over-claimed.
Mutagen drawbacks are real negative modifiers on shipped consumable modes, so with no suppression lane this alchemist's sheet shows wrong numbers.
Permanent quickened — the RECORD_MARKERS condition lane already used by eternal-boost and full-automation.
FEAT_LANE_GRANTS already carries the identical shape for diverse-weapon-expert, and the fix leaves the per-character advanced weapon ungranted.
snareAllowance() really does return the prepared count the builder renders and takes only the Crafting rank, so the feat is provably inert — a one-line change to existing code, not a new subsystem.

The feat is a table-resolved action and its free daily poisons are inventory ITEMS — the same batch ruled pilgrims-token NEEDS_NOTHING for exactly that ('no grant field for items'), and the proposed allowance has no surface outside the alchemist-gated AlchemyPanel.
A flat permanent benefit, and critSpec is paired with critSpecWeapons {groups:['polearm']} so it cannot spread to every weapon — matching hobgoblin-weapon-discipline.
